info.name: Horizon Weaver Initiate
info.description: The Horizon Weaver Initiate background from Arcana Unleashed.

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Weaver's Tools, Map, Quiver, Rope, Traveler's Clothes, 18 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: Your adolescence was marked by unquenchable wanderlust. You left home and began your travels as soon as you were able. Along the way, you encountered the adventurous conjurers of the Horizon Weavers, who taught you some of their teleportation magic to further your explorations.

setters.set: Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom, Portal Jumper Feat, Acrobatics and Survival Skills, Weaver's Tools
